appearance.body: A wiry, underfed adult male orc foot soldier from a grim Tolkien-like battlefield: narrow hunched shoulders, long arms, sinewy limbs, bony face, crooked nose, uneven small tusks, long pointed ears, sallow grey-green skin and sparse dark hair. Patched worn leather, scraps of dull iron on only one shoulder and one knee, coarse dark cloth and mismatched bindings. Dusty charcoal, swamp-olive and rust-brown palette, deliberately asymmetrical and rough. A low-ranking survivor with a memorable face and silhouette, not a brute and not a polished champion.

Textual inspiration: the rough, diminished Orc foot-soldier archetype from Tolkien battlefield fantasy, with an original face, silhouette and armor; do not reproduce a named film or book character.
